error_codes.name: BOND_ORACLE_THROW_UNAUTHORIZED
error_codes.description: in.senderAddress is not in the authorized reporter address registry

error_codes.name: BOND_ORACLE_THROW_INSUFFICIENT_BOND
error_codes.description: in.valueCoins < BOND_ORACLE_MIN_BOND (1 TOS) on a SubmitReport message

error_codes.name: BOND_ORACLE_THROW_NO_ACTIVE_ROUND
error_codes.description: A SubmitReport or Finalize message arrived when no round is active

error_codes.name: SLICE5_ORACLE_THROW_UNAUTHORIZED_REPORTER
error_codes.description: Stdlib: resolved reporter key not found in the reporter set map

error_codes.name: SLICE5_ORACLE_THROW_DUPLICATE_REPORTER
error_codes.description: Stdlib: reporter key has already submitted a report in this round

error_codes.name: SLICE5_ORACLE_THROW_INSUFFICIENT_QUORUM
error_codes.description: Stdlib: finalize called before quorum report count was reached

error_codes.name: SLICE5_ORACLE_THROW_OUTLIER
error_codes.description: Stdlib: submitted value deviates > maxDeviation from the running median anchor

error_codes.name: SLICE5_ORACLE_THROW_REPLAYED_ROUND
error_codes.description: Stdlib: roundId <= state.lastRoundId (non-monotonic start) or mismatched roundId in report/finalize

error_codes.name: SLICE5_ORACLE_THROW_BAD_CONFIG
error_codes.description: Stdlib: invalid oracle configuration at deploy time

error_codes.name: SLICE5_ORACLE_THROW_ROUND_FINALIZED
error_codes.description: Stdlib: attempted to finalize an already-finalized round

error_codes.name: SLICE5_ORACLE_THROW_UNAUTHORIZED_STARTER
error_codes.description: Stdlib: in.senderAddress != config.roundStarter on a StartRound message
